{{Top|leg}}
A '''Visitor Consumption Tag''', known simply as '''viscount''', was a certificate issued by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] for a small fee that allowed visitors to purchase goods at a twenty percent discount.
